lifecycle.title: How Knowledge Lives and Grows
lifecycle.subtitle: Every piece of content in EduBek moves through this ten-step cycle. Step ten feeds back into step one — for new teachers, the work of past teachers is already waiting.
lifecycle.loopIndicator: Step 10 → Step 1: future teachers inherit a richer library

1.title: Idea
1.description: A teacher realizes they need something. EduBek helps determine the best way to obtain it.

2.title: Search Before Creating
2.description: Check personal library → org library → global Marketplace. Reuse knowledge before creating new knowledge.

3.title: Create or Customize
3.description: Create manually, generate with AI, customize an existing resource, or combine multiple resources.

4.title: Save
4.description: Every resource is saved. Teachers build a personal library over time.

5.title: Use in Teaching
5.description: Assign as homework, host a live quiz, present during class. The same resource may be used many times.

6.title: Collect Learning Data
6.description: Completion rate, average score, difficult questions, common mistakes, time spent.

7.title: Improve
7.description: Correct mistakes, rewrite explanations, replace confusing questions. Resources become better through real classroom experience.

8.title: Publish (Optional)
8.description: Publish to the Marketplace — private, org-only, or public. Teacher always has complete ownership.

9.title: Help Other Teachers
9.description: Other educators discover, purchase, customize, teach, and improve it. One teacher's work becomes valuable to many.

10.title: Continue Growing
10.description: Updates, translations, grade adaptations. Educational content should improve over time rather than becoming outdated.

economy.title: Real Money Rewards Expertise. EduTokens Power AI.
economy.subtitle: Two currencies, two purposes. Real Money preserves long-term value from human expertise. EduTokens pay for short-lived computational work performed by the AI.

realMoney.name: Real Money
realMoney.represents: Human expertise — educational materials with long-term value

eduTokens.name: EduTokens
eduTokens.represents: Computational work — temporary value, performs a task once

principles.title: The Constitution of EduBek
principles.subtitle: Every feature, decision, and line of code is measured against these fourteen principles. Explore them by group:

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.description: The core mindset that shapes every decision.

ux.label: UX
ux.description: How teachers and students experience the product.

ecosystem.label: Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: How every contribution makes the whole stronger.

trust.label: Trust
trust.description: Transparency and user control build confidence.

quality.label: Quality & Scale
quality.description: Do fewer things well, built to scale from day one.

1.title: Solve Problems, Not Requests
1.summary: Users don't want AI — they have an educational problem. Focus on the real problem, not blindly completing the request.

2.title: Reuse Knowledge Before Creating Knowledge
2.summary: Always ask: 'Does a good solution already exist?' Reuse → improve → only create new when nothing suitable exists.

3.title: AI Supports People
3.summary: AI doesn't replace teachers, creators, or educational experience. Teachers make decisions; AI removes repetitive work.

4.title: Simplicity Is Better Than Complexity
4.summary: Teachers should never feel overwhelmed. The best feature is often the one teachers barely notice because it works naturally.

5.title: Every Feature Should Save Time
5.summary: If a feature adds steps without significant value, redesign it. Time is one of the most valuable resources teachers have.

6.title: Respect Ownership
6.summary: Private work stays private. Org resources stay inside the org unless shared. Marketplace resources always recognize original creators.

7.title: Every Action Should Strengthen the Ecosystem
7.summary: Knowledge should continuously accumulate rather than disappear. Every contribution makes the platform more valuable for everyone else.

8.title: The User Is Always in Control
8.summary: AI makes recommendations; teachers make decisions. The platform should assist rather than control.

9.title: Transparency Builds Trust
9.summary: Users should understand why something happened. Hidden decisions create confusion.

10.title: Quality Is More Important Than Quantity
10.summary: Doing fewer things well is better than doing many things poorly.

11.title: Build for the Future
11.summary: Scalability should be considered from the beginning.

12.title: One Platform, One Experience
12.summary: Users should never feel that they are switching between systems. Boundaries exist for developers, not for users.

13.title: Education Comes First
13.summary: Technology exists to improve education. Education does not exist to showcase technology.

14.title: Continuous Improvement
14.summary: EduBek is never 'finished.' Evolve based on real educational needs, not trends.

cycle.title: A Self-Improving Ecosystem
cycle.subtitle: Knowledge never disappears in EduBek — it compounds. Each loop makes the library richer for the next teacher who joins.
cycle.footer: Each pass through the loop leaves the library richer than it was before — for the next teacher, the next class, and the next generation of learners.
cycle.loop: This cycle repeats, continuously improving the library
